spec.rationale: Types the owner-earnings leg of the prose falsifier for the operating-business DCF. The low-case bridge grows normalized owner earnings from the locked FY2025 anchor (13024.8 USD millions: operating cash flow minus capital expenditures, converted from EUR at the evidenced 2025-12-31 rate per ASML/research/valuation_fact_ledger.json). A resolved value below that anchor at FY2026 year-end means cash conversion has fallen below the low-case bridge; incremental-returns and reinvestment-runway legs remain judgment-only and are not typed. ASML files annual 20-F only (no interim 10-Q), so resolution uses the locked fact-ledger field normalized_owner_earnings_m rather than quarterly TTM reconstruction. Observable after the expected FY2026 20-F (prior filing landed 2026-02-25 for FY2025) plus 60 days to resolution.
